text:
Maya (PM): quick sync on embedding endpoint priorities. customers keep asking for higher-dim support + smoother migrations. want clear GA plan by EOD.
Sam (Eng-Platform): reality check: 1024 dims is our fast path. 4096 is possible but multiplies memory and latency. recommend GA focuses on 1024 public, 4096 as invite-only. need per-tenant gating for pro model.
Luca (Eng-ML): agrees. recommend default model open-embed-v1 (1024). open-embed-pro (4096) available with opt-in. note: normalization and distance scale differ; docs must call this out.
Sophia (Eng): engineering constraints: we can't easily pack mixed-dimension outputs in a single tensor. options: clients pick requested dim per request; server enforces single-dim-per-request. mixed-dim migration should be handled client-side or via a helper adapter.
Ken (Product): FinPartner asked for server-side up/down projection during migration. they're willing to pay but want it turnkey.
Sam (Eng-Platform): projection adapter doable but risky for quality. propose offering migration helper library + reference implementation. auto-projection in server would be behind a long-lived feature flag and limited partners only.
Maya (PM): launch acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) API contract final (single-dim-per-request), 2) migration guide and helper lib, 3) perf benchmarks for 1024/4096, 4) quota gating for 4096 (invite-only), 5) 2-3 partner integrations validated.
Luca (Eng-ML): add blocking evaluation: projection path must not degrade retrieval performance by >5% (downstream eval). run intrinsic similarity and downstream retrieval tests.
Sophia (Eng): batching policy: for hosted we can keep continuous batching but set safe defaults: max_inputs_per_request=512 for GA public; server-side batching up to 2048 for burst. Dedicated can have higher per-tenant override. note SLO impact for >512.
Ken (Product): response formats: customers want small JSON and a binary mode for speed. propose default JSON: {"data": [{"id": "...", "embedding": [ ... ] }]} and optional binary content-type application/x-embeddings-binary. clients choose via Accept/Content-Type.
Sam (Eng-Platform): binary is fine. we must define header (endianness, float32 vs float16), and error semantics for mixed-dim or quota violations. return 400 with structured error code + docs link for common migration errors.
Maya (PM): streaming for very large uploads? some partners want progressive results.
Sophia (Eng): streaming possible with chunked transfer but complicates ordering and retries. mark as stretch for v1.1.
Luca (Eng-ML): routing: default model when omitted = open-embed-v1. explicit param ?model=open-embed-pro to request pro. server will only serve pro if tenant flag + capacity.
Ken (Product): pricing: 4096 should be a premium tier; legal also needs retention policy clarified.
Maya (PM): decision recap: GA public = 1024 JSON default, max_inputs=512, binary & 4096 invite-only, mixed-dim via client + migration lib. blockers?
Sam (Eng-Platform): infra blocker: per-tenant quota gating + billing tag not complete. timeline: 2 sprints to support invite-only gating. without gating, we can do public 1024 GA sooner.
Sophia (Eng): binary format blocker: need a spec (header layout, dtype). leaning toward little-endian float32 with a short header (version, count, dim).
Luca (Eng-ML): we'll produce quantized float16 option later and include size/perf tables.
Ken (Product): customers pushing for quick GA. propose limited GA public 1024 JSON + invite-only partners for 4096 and binary.
Maya (PM): sounds good. GA1 checklist: API schema doc, migration guide + helper lib, perf benchmarks + evaluation, basic billing hooks, partner integrations (2). owners?
Sam (Eng-Platform): I own infra gating + billing hooks (deliver by sprint 3 for invite-only flow).
Sophia (Eng): I own binary format spec + server encoder + tests.
Luca (Eng-ML): I own model docs, evals, and projection guidance.
Ken (Product): I own partner outreach and pricing comms.
Maya (PM): action items: @Sam prototype gating, @Sophia publish draft binary header, @Luca run projection evals including failure cases, @Ken pull partner list. sync tomorrow 10:30. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng-Platform): will post short design doc to #eng-platform after prototype.
Sophia (Eng): will paste binary header gist in thread.
Luca (Eng-ML): will attach eval notebook to PR.
Ken (Product): will start partner outreach doc.
Maya (PM): thanks, I'll convert notes into a short RFC after sync and loop in legal for retention language.
